SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'BUSC' AND TABLE_NAME = 'DID_USERACCESSMATRIX'

UserID	bigint
UserName	varchar(200)
UserRole	varchar(40)
UserEmail	varchar(60)
BranchID	varchar(20)
PCCCode	varchar(20)
BankID	varchar(20)
SourceSystemCode	varchar(20)
isActive	int
isLatest	int
BNK_CODE	varchar(20)
SOURCE_CODE	varchar(20)
FILE_NAME	varchar(100)
insert_dttm	datetime2


CREATE TABLE [d360].[STG_EDS_DID_USERACCESSMATRIX]
(
	[H] [varchar](25) NULL,
	[UserID]	bigint,
	[UserName]	varchar(200),
	[UserRole]	varchar(40),
	[UserEmail]	varchar(60),
	[BranchID]	varchar(20),
	[PCCCode]	varchar(20),
	[BankID]	varchar(20),
	[SourceSystemCode]	varchar(20),
	[FILE_NAME]	varchar(100),
	[insert_dttm]	datetime2
)
WITH
(
	DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN,
	HEAP
)
GO


CREATE TABLE [d360].[STG_EDS_DID_USERACCESSMATRIX_SELECT_SRC]
( 
	[UserID]	bigint,
	[UserName]	varchar(200),
	[UserRole]	varchar(40),
	[UserEmail]	varchar(60),
	[BranchID]	varchar(20),
	[PCCCode]	varchar(20),
	[BankID]	varchar(20),
	[SourceSystemCode]	varchar(20),
	[FILE_NAME] [varchar](100)  NULL,
	[JSRC_FLG] [int]  NOT NULL,
	[JTAR_FLG] [int]  NOT NULL
)
WITH
(
	DISTRIBUTION = REPLICATE,
	HEAP
);
GO


CREATE TABLE [d360].[STG_EDS_DID_USERACCESSMATRIX_GROUP_SRC]
( 
	[UserID]	bigint,
	[UserName]	varchar(200),
	[UserRole]	varchar(40),
	[UserEmail]	varchar(60),
	[BranchID]	varchar(20),
	[PCCCode]	varchar(20),
	[BankID]	varchar(20),
	[SourceSystemCode]	varchar(20),
	[FILE_NAME] [VARCHAR](100)  NULL,
	[JSRC_FLG_CNT] [int]  NULL,
	[JTAR_FLG_CNT] [int]  NULL,
	[FILE_DATE] [date]  NULL
)
WITH
(
	DISTRIBUTION = REPLICATE,
	HEAP
);
GO


CREATE TABLE [EDS].[DID_USERACCESSMATRIX]
( 
	[UserID]	bigint,
	[UserName]	varchar(200),
	[UserRole]	varchar(40),
	[UserEmail]	varchar(60),
	[BranchID]	varchar(20),
	[PCCCode]	varchar(20),
	[BankID]	varchar(20),
	[SourceSystemCode]	varchar(20),
	[SCD_Start_Date] [date]  NULL,
	[SCD_End_Date] [date]  NULL,
	[isActive] [char](1)  NULL,
	[isLatest] [char](1)  NULL,
	[BNK_CODE] [varchar](20)  NULL,
	[SOURCE_CODE] [varchar](20)  NULL,
	[FILE_NAME] [varchar](100)  NULL,
	[insert_dttm] [datetime]  NULL
)
WITH
(
	DISTRIBUTION = HASH([UserID]),
	HEAP
);
GO
